record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Related to Fixed Point Properties
record.original_question: Let S be a discrete semigroup. Define (fpp*s) to mean that whenever S = {T_s : s in S} is a norm nonexpansive representation on a nonempty norm-separable weak* compact convex subset C of the dual E* of a Banach space E, and (s, x) -> T_s(x) from S x C to C is jointly continuous when C carries the weak* topology, then C has a common fixed point. If S has property (fpp*s), must WAP(S) have a left invariant mean? Conversely, if WAP(S) has a left invariant mean, is that sufficient to ensure (fpp*s)?

evidence.quote: (fpp∗s) Whenever S = {Ts : s ∈ S} is a norm nonexpansive representation of S on a nonempty norm separable weak* compact convex set C of the dual space of a Banach space E and the mapping (s, x) 7→ Ts(x) from S × C to C is jointly continuous when C is endowed with the weak* topology of E∗, then there is a common fixed point for S in C.

Problem 2.4. Let S be a (discrete) semigroup. If the fixed point property (fpp∗s) holds, does W AP(S) have a LIM? We also do not know whether the existence of a LIM on W AP(S) is sufficient to ensure the fixed point property (fpp∗s).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a discrete semigroup. Denote by $\ell^\infty(S)$ the space of bounded complex-valued functions on $S$, and by $\mathrm{WAP}(S) \subseteq \ell^\infty(S)$ the closed subspace of weakly almost periodic functions, i.e., those $f \in \ell^\infty(S)$ for which the left orbit $\{\ell_s f : s \in S\}$ (where $(\ell_s f)(t) = f(st)$) is relatively weakly compact in $\ell^\infty(S)$. A left invariant mean (LIM) on $\mathrm{WAP}(S)$ is a positive linear functional $m$ of norm $1$ such that $m(\ell_s f) = m(f)$ for all $s \in S$ and all $f \in \mathrm{WAP}(S)$.

Say that $S$ has the fixed point property (fpp*s) if the following holds: whenever $E$ is a Banach space, $C$ is a nonempty norm-separable weak* compact convex subset of the dual space $E^*$, and $\{T_s : s \in S\}$ is a representation of $S$ on $C$ by norm-nonexpansive maps $T_s : C \to C$ satisfying $T_{st} = T_s \circ T_t$ for all $s,t \in S$, such that the action $(s,x) \mapsto T_s(x)$ from $S \times C \to C$ is jointly continuous when $C$ carries the weak* topology, then there exists $x_0 \in C$ with $T_s(x_0) = x_0$ for all $s \in S$.

Address the following two questions:

(a) If $S$ has property (fpp*s), must $\mathrm{WAP}(S)$ admit a left invariant mean?

(b) Conversely, if $\mathrm{WAP}(S)$ admits a left invariant mean, must $S$ have property (fpp*s)?
artifact.status_search_result: This problem appears in a collection of open problems on fixed point properties associated with semigroup representations. Existing literature (e.g., Lau–Zhang and related work) establishes implications between the existence of a LIM on WAP(S) and various weak/weak* fixed point properties under additional hypotheses, but the precise equivalence with (fpp*s) for general discrete semigroups does not appear to be resolved in either direction. No source located confirms a solution.

status_evidence.title: Normal Structure and Common Fixed Point Properties for Semigroups of Nonexpansive Mappings in Banach Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: If WAP(S) has a LIM, then a separable semitopological semigroup S has a fixed point property for nonexpansive representations on weakly compact convex sets.
status_evidence.claim: Related implications between LIM on WAP(S) and fixed point properties are known, but the weak*-compact joint-continuity version (fpp*s) is treated separately.

status_evidence.title: Fixed point properties for semigroups of nonlinear mappings on unbounded sets
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses fixed point properties for semigroup representations and their relations to invariant means.
status_evidence.claim: The relation between (fpp*s) and LIM on WAP(S) is part of a series of open questions in this area.
